concept: Which strategies survive realistic fees and slippage
summary: Source-anchored research for Which strategies survive realistic fees and slippage. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Market-neutral copula-based pairs trading on ten Binance USDT perpetuals (hourly, Jan 2021 to Dec 2023) produced negative net returns at a baseline cost of 0.08% per round trip, with drawdowns under 20%; the version with directional overlay only tracked buy-and-hold. (low confidence)
